How to read this comparison

Real cross-city analysis must align observation periods, cloud masks, spatial scale, and geographic boundaries. Weather and acquisition dates affect satellite temperatures. These sample values demonstrate the interface only.

BEHIND THE MAP

Make the model explain itself.

PLANNED WORKFLOW

From satellite to insight

  1. Collect

    Landsat surface temperature and reflectance, national land-cover data, and city boundaries.

  2. Prepare

    Mask clouds, align observation periods, calculate NDVI, and aggregate to a common grid.

  3. Train

    Compare random forest regression with a linear regression baseline.

  4. Evaluate

    Use spatially separated test areas and hold out cities to measure transfer performance.

Data sources & interpretation

Planned sources: USGS Landsat, MRLC land cover, and Census boundaries. They are not yet connected to this prototype.

Satellite land surface temperature describes the surface at observation time. It is not a direct measure of air temperature, health risk, or personal heat exposure. Demo grid cells are schematic and do not represent city boundaries.
